title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Public Listening Facilities and Spoken Guidance
prompt: In many cities, public spaces such as museums, transit hubs, and parks now provide short recorded audio guides that help visitors navigate maps, locate facilities, and understand instructions. Some people argue that these listening aids make public places more accessible and enjoyable, while others believe they reduce visitors' attention to their surroundings and create unnecessary dependence on technology. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on whether spoken guidance should be expanded in public facilities. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确题目要求：讨论双方观点并给出自己的立场。建议用约5分钟规划：第一段引出话题并表明立场；主体段一论述支持语音导览的理由（如无障碍、效率）；主体段二论述反对理由（如注意力分散、技术依赖）；最后一段重申观点并总结。注意使用具体例子但不要编造统计数据。写完后检查是否达到250词、是否回应了双方观点、是否有清晰立场。
